## Remarks

Caption text comes from the `<g-base id>` block via `getGMessage` and is sent via `editMessageCaption`<!-- -->. Fallback modes mirror `renderEdit`<!-- -->: `delete-reply`<!-- -->/`reply` resend the caption as plain text, `disable` throws.
